profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Hallmark Cards
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with 12+ years at Hallmark Cards, focused on enterprise .NET/C# systems, cloud-hosted services, and internal platform integrations. Currently building and maintaining digital asset management solutions on AWS, including custom Windows services, REST APIs, and automated content workflows. I enjoy solving infrastructure problems with clean, maintainable code and have a strong background in both greenfield development and keeping legacy systems healthy. Outside of my day job, I co-founded BlizzPro.com, a long-running Blizzard Entertainment fan media site, which has become its own engineering and automation playground.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading development of internal tools and integrations supporting Hallmark's digital asset management platform (Cosmos, built on MediaBeacon). Responsibilities include designing and maintaining a suite of .NET Windows services, building REST APIs consumed by internal teams, and integrating with enterprise systems across the organization. Work spans C#/.NET Core, Solr/search infrastructure, and SMB/NAS file system integrations.

positions.title: Senior Developer/Analyst
positions.description: Expertise and lead developer on several projects primarily with building enterprise level APIs with .NET Web API and moving forward with .NET Core 2.0 and beyond.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
On a team building a web application with C#, MVC4, Entity Framework, Dependency Injection, JSON, AJAX, NUnit. Uses DB2 for data backend and Solr for search functionality.

The team is run using the agile methodology that involves some Kanban, pair programming, and even mob programming. Also uses Test Driven Development. Team also tries to adhere to SOLID principles.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Co-founded and continue to develop BlizzPro.com, an official Blizzard Entertainment fan news site with over 13 years of operation. Responsible for all technical infrastructure including WordPress hosting, CI/CD workflows, and an Azure-backed AI content pipeline that automates news scraping, drafting, and multi-platform publishing (WordPress, Facebook, Bluesky). Also produce and support the BlizzPro YouTube channel.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: VeriShip provides a recovery audit of FedEx and UPS invoices to secure refunds for late deliveries and other service failures.  VeriShip’s proprietary software automates refund claims while also providing business intelligence for reducing additional shipping expenses.

positions.title: Development Advisor
positions.description:
-Personally converted over 80 clients from 3rd party CMS solution to in-house developed solution

-Involved in sprint planning, tech design, and test planning in an agile methodology environment

-Provided analysis, modification, debugging, and testing of C# applications for performance related issues and worked with the development team on better solutions

-Other duties included providing regression and unit testing to ensure the success of applications being implemented

-Utilized CSS and HTML to help fix designs for various web sites

-Developed several SQL scripts on various projects for testing purposes

positions.title: Managing Editor
positions.description: Managed http://wow.stratics.com - bringing news, content, and community all together on things related to leading MMO game World of Warcraft.

positions.title: Support Engineer II
positions.description:
-Provided analysis and support of bugs written in C#, ASP.NET, and SQL Server to determine client problems and provide manipulation for the Storefront - Ecommerce business; this involved changing settings and escalating issues

-Performed manipulation and modifications of DHTML and HTML to assist customers with trouble issues, primarily over the phone with customers who were having issues with their storefront.net ecommerce software

-Developed custom scripts as needed to help fix data issues

-Other duties included analysis and solution with small custom code fixes, developed or filled out bug reports and sent them to development

positions.title: System Administrator/Web Developer
positions.description:
-Duties included the installation, configuation, and administration of Windows 2000 and 2003 servers for web servers hosting over 2,000 custom made dental web sites for Internet Dental Alliance

-Developed a C# application that pulled weather data from the National Weather Service Feed and then displayed the information in an easy read format, was utilized by the local cable company to display weather over the air

-Performed analysis, coding, and modifications of CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and MySQL as needed to cover client's changes and requests

-Involved in early stages of developing CMS solution for Internet Dental Alliance

-Maintained office computers, equipment, and phone systems

projects.title: BlizzPro.TV - BlizzPro Weekly
projects.description:
Design of images used during the filming of the BlizzPro Weekly show.
Promotional/Social Media material and logo design.
